decision_conditions: The proposed first floor rear extension, by reason of its depth, l-shaped design and gabled roof, would appear as an incongruous and visually intrusive form of development within the rear garden scene that would be harmful to the character and appearance of the host property and surrounding area, contrary to Local Plan Policies 7 and 26, Policy D4 of the London Plan (2021) and the Residential Extensions and Alterations Supplementary Planning Document.

The proposed first floor rear extension, by reason of its depth and proximity to the attached shared boundary, would have an overbearing impact on and result in a loss of outlook to the first floor rear bedroom window of no. 12 Little Aston Road, contrary to Local Plan Policies 7 and 26 and the Residential Extensions and Alterations Supplementary Planning Document.

Statement Required by Article 35 (2) of the Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015: In accordance with paragraph 38 of the National Planning Policy Framework, improvements required to make the proposal acceptable were suggested to the agent via email on 12/12/2025. The revisions involved reducing its depth and width so as for it to project 3m deep set off the attached shared boundary by 2m with a hipped roof. The applicants declined to make the suggested revisions however.
description: First floor rear extension and alterations to fenestration
